persona_summary: Tyler prefers names grounded in real things and concise outcomes before procedural detail in Meadow Notes. During incidents, immediate commands come before explanation. These are project-specific, not universal preferences.
scenario: Prepare an ordinary Meadow Notes release handoff after Tyler changed the preferred order.

alternatives.content: For Meadow-notes, use names grounded in real things and avoid generic tech-oriented branding. For ordinary handoffs, lead with a one-sentence outcome, then provide details. During incidents, put immediate commands before explanatory context.
